profile_text.body:
Super Micro Computer, Inc. is a public company headquartered in San Jose, California, and trades under the ticker SMCI. Its SEC filing identifier is 0001375365. On its own website the company describes itself as a provider of advanced Server Building Block Solutions for 5G/Edge, data center, cloud, enterprise, big data, HPC and embedded markets worldwide.

The site presents GPU servers for modern data centers and describes its AI systems as featuring multi-GPU and interconnect technologies. It also lists short-depth and small form factor systems intended to deliver compute, AI and connectivity performance to the edge of the network.

The company's recorded legal exposure is in California, with a count of 270. No lawsuits are listed against it, and no MCP servers are recorded for it.
